name: @ens-apps/dqa-server
description: DQA overlay service: comment persistence, image upload, live cursor relay, Linear OAuth + push. Serves the overlay bundle (client/overlay.js, built by Vite into dist/) for injection into QA/preview builds. Server TypeScript runs directly under Node's native type stripping.
